description:
An open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Microsoft Word, rebuilt in pure Rust

WordCraft is an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Microsoft Word, rebuilt in pure Rust. It opens and saves .docx (OOXML), plus .odt, .rtf, .html, .md and .txt, and exports PDF with real, selectable text, links and bookmarks. Native egui on the GPU with no Electron and no Tauri, one codebase for macOS, Windows, Linux, BSD and the web.

- Familiar: Word's ribbon tabs, groups, shortcuts and behaviour, a live Styles gallery, regex find and replace, and spelling and grammar as you type.
- Writing and formatting: fast typing with IME, smart quotes, AutoCorrect, list autoformat, fonts, character and paragraph formatting, styles, themes and style sets.
- Pages: margins, orientation, size, columns, page, column and section breaks, headers and footers, page numbers, watermarks, page borders, line numbers, drop caps and automatic hyphenation.
- Tables and objects: tables with styles, merged and split cells, formulas and repeating header rows; pictures, shapes and text boxes with floating positions and text wrapping.
- References: tables of contents, footnotes and endnotes, citations and a bibliography in APA, MLA, Chicago or IEEE, captions, cross-references and an index.
- Review: track changes, margin comment balloons, accept and reject, compare documents, restrict editing, an accessibility checker, thesaurus and word count.
- Mailings: mail merge from CSV with merge fields, address blocks and greeting lines, envelopes and labels.
- Built for agents: 389 commands drive the ribbon, shortcuts, command search, the CLI, a JSON control channel and an MCP server. Everything works offline, and the interface ships in English, 简体中文, 繁體中文 and 日本語.
